Leaflet 1.9.4, BSD-2-Clause; copyright/license text is in `LICENSE.leaflet`.

Retrieved November 5, 2026 from the published package:

- https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js
- https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css
- https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/LICENSE

Only line endings/trailing whitespace were normalized. Assets are served locally;
there is no CDN dependency at runtime. The app uses vector/circle layers, so the
unused standard marker image assets are not required. No external tiles are used.
